info.title: DailySpeak API
info.description: HTTP API for DailySpeak. Mobile and web clients share `/api/v1/auth/*`, short-lived Bearer access tokens, and rotating opaque refresh tokens. Native clients receive refresh tokens in JSON; browser requests use a scoped HttpOnly refresh cookie. Remaining unversioned web resource routes also require Bearer access tokens while they migrate to `/api/v1`.

get.summary: Health check
Readiness check
get.description: Reports whether PostgreSQL is reachable and durable work remains within the configured admission thresholds. Use this endpoint for load-balancer admission, not process restarts.

200.description: The API is ready to accept traffic.

503.description: A required dependency is unavailable or durable work is above an admission threshold.

get.summary: Read the current mobile API version

post.summary: Create a short-lived guest identity
Register an account and optionally upgrade a guest
post.description: When a guest Bearer token is supplied, its identity is merged into the new account in the same transaction. guestPreviewPromotion reports whether the bounded preview became the stable account recording.

post.summary: Sign in and optionally merge a guest identity
post.description: When a guest Bearer token is supplied, its identity and current bounded preview are merged into the account atomically. guestPreviewPromotion reports the result.

post.summary: Rotate a refresh token and issue a new access token
post.description: Each refresh token is single-use. Reuse revokes the entire device session. Originless native clients send `refreshToken` in the JSON body. Browser requests are detected by `Origin`, send `{}`, and use the rotating HttpOnly `daily_speaking_refresh` cookie; a browser cannot select JSON refresh-token delivery by changing `platform`.

get.summary: Read the current identity and device session

post.summary: Revoke the current device session
Revoke every device session for the current identity

get.summary: List active device sessions

post.summary: Create the single bounded guest preview
post.description: Attaches one owned ready guest audio asset and queues transcription plus at most two high-confidence corrections. It never starts full multipass analysis, rewrite, or shadowing. The actual audio duration is verified server-side and must not exceed 180 seconds.

get.summary: Load the owned guest preview
get.description: Returns only the bounded preview result. After account upgrade, continue polling the same id through `/api/v1/recordings/{recordingId}`.

get.summary: List owned recordings with cursor pagination
get.description: Returns recordings ordered by timestamp and id descending. Cursors are opaque and must be sent back unchanged.

post.summary: Create a recording from ready media assets
post.description: Atomically attaches owned ready audio and optional photo assets, enforces the 600-second per-recording account limit, and enqueues durable processing. A user access token and an Idempotency-Key are required; guest identities cannot start paid processing.

get.summary: Load one owned recording from the v1 API

delete.description: Deletes the recording, its attached product data, and durably queues owned media for removal.

post.summary: Retry one failed processing stage
post.description: Resumes the owned recording from its persisted failed stage without duplicating already-running work.

post.summary: Schedule pronunciation audio generation
post.description: Schedules owned ready recording shadowing through the durable worker, using the saved corrected learner transcript without an extra model call. Ready experimental fictional sample audio with shadowingScript is replaced once; other ready learner audio and processing work are reused. The replacement clears shadowingScript and retires its old audio through bounded background cleanup.

post.summary: Create an owned resumable media upload
post.description: Creates an upload plan for recording audio, an interview-turn WAV, or a recording photo. The client computes the complete-object SHA-256 before starting. Guest identities may create bounded interview-turn WAV uploads for their owned active interview and one recording_audio upload for the final bounded preview; guest photos are rejected.

get.summary: Resume an owned media upload
get.description: Returns upload state and the parts already accepted by storage. A foreign upload is reported as not found.

delete.description: Idempotently aborts an incomplete upload. A completed upload cannot be aborted.

post.summary: Create short-lived upload requests for media parts
post.description: Returns opaque bounded upload requests. Send exactly the returned method, URL, and headers; URLs are short-lived and must never be persisted.

post.summary: Complete and verify an owned media upload
post.description: Completes multipart storage and verifies the whole-object size and SHA-256. Repeating a successful completion is idempotent.

get.summary: Create a short-lived authorized media download request
get.description: Returns an opaque request for an owned ready asset. Foreign, deleted, and non-ready assets are all reported as not found. The returned URL must not be persisted.

put.summary: Upload one part to local media storage
put.description: Local-storage transport endpoint. Invoke only the opaque signed URL returned by the parts endpoint. Signature, expiry, size, and checksum are bound into the URL; no bearer token is sent.

get.summary: Download signed content from local media storage
get.description: Local-storage transport endpoint. Invoke only the opaque signed URL returned by the authorized download endpoint; no bearer token is sent.

get.summary: Generate daily speaking questions
get.description: Returns three opening questions on different broad subjects by default, or one replacement when count=1. Each can start a longer interview. Uses an optional Bearer access token. If authenticated, the user's saved English level overrides the `level` query parameter, and saved opening topics or dismissed questions from the account's full history are excluded.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of opening questions to generate. Use 1 to replace a single dismissed card.

parameters.name: current
parameters.description: Other questions remaining on screen when count=1; may be repeated. The replacement must have a different subject.

parameters.name: avoid
parameters.description: Additional opening questions to avoid; may be repeated. The generator considers up to 20 distinct client-supplied questions in addition to the authenticated account's full answered and dismissed question history.

post.summary: Never suggest an opening question again
post.description: Saves a question exclusion for the authenticated account. Repeating the same request is safe.

get.summary: Generate follow-up questions and words for a topic
get.description: The selected topic question is the first interview question. Returns ten distinct follow-up questions and eight useful words or short phrases for that same topic, for eleven interview questions in total.

get.summary: Generate a vocabulary pack
Load user profile, quota and subscription
Read subscription and recording limits

post.summary: Activate or extend subscription by one month

get.summary: Read saved English level

post.summary: Prepare an adaptive topic interview
post.description: Creates an owned session and schedules generation of words for the opening question plus one hidden next question with its own answer words. Both guest and account Bearer identities are supported.

get.summary: Read an adaptive interview session
get.description: Returns presented turns with their answer words, provisional transcripts, and at most one hidden next question with its own answer words. If the next question is missing and no answer processing or refill job is active, polling schedules a rate-limited durable refill.

post.summary: Start recording an adaptive interview
Present the next prepared or adaptive question
post.description: Closes the current turn at atMs and atomically consumes a candidate. Set skipCurrent when the learner chooses not to answer; that turn is excluded from the final dialogue and analysis. The client may display its prefetched text immediately while this request is acknowledged.

post.summary: Create a short-lived Cartesia STT credential
post.description: Starts a ready interview when necessary, then returns an STT-only access token bounded by the remaining interview duration and the manual Ink 2 WebSocket configuration. The server keeps CARTESIA_API_KEY private.

post.summary: Create a short-lived Cartesia TTS credential
post.description: Returns a TTS-only access token, bounded to 60 seconds and the remaining active interview duration, plus the configured Cartesia /tts/bytes parameters. The server keeps CARTESIA_API_KEY private.

post.summary: Attach a self-contained answer audio segment
post.description: The audioAssetId must refer to an owned ready interview_turn_audio WAV upload. The segment is retained with the interview and is transcribed through Cartesia batch STT only when no realtime transcript was saved for this turn.

post.summary: Save a finalized realtime answer transcript
post.description: Persists the final Ink 2 text for one answer and schedules adaptive question generation. The transcript is idempotent and becomes the canonical text for this turn.

post.summary: Skip the active unanswered interview turn
post.description: Closes the latest unanswered turn and excludes its question from the final dialogue, analysis, and shadowing script. The operation conflicts once answer audio or transcript evidence has been stored.

post.summary: Finalize the interview timeline
post.description: Closes the last turn and confirms the recording or guest preview already linked atomically during creation with interviewSessionId. The complete audio remains available for playback, while canonical interview text is assembled from the finalized turn transcripts without retranscribing the complete file.

post.summary: Cancel an unsaved adaptive interview
post.description: Releases the principal's single active interview session. This cannot cancel an interview already attached to a recording or guest preview.

post.summary: Retry good-example analysis
post.description: Schedules durable positive-feedback processing for an owned recording after corrections are saved. Repeated calls while processing or ready do not enqueue another job. Corrections, the natural practice version, and shadowing remain unchanged.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access token returned by `/api/v1/auth/*`. Native refresh tokens are sent only to the refresh endpoint; browsers use a scoped HttpOnly refresh cookie.

RequestIdHeader.name: X-Request-ID
RequestIdHeader.description: Caller-generated diagnostic id. Unsafe values are replaced by the server.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Stable key for retrying this logical mutation. Reusing it with a different request returns a conflict.

MediaSignedSizeQuery.name: sizeBytes
MediaSignedSizeQuery.description: Signed exact Content-Length for this local upload part.

MediaSignedChecksumQuery.name: checksumSha256
MediaSignedChecksumQuery.description: Signed lowercase SHA-256 for this local upload part.

MediaSignedExpiryQuery.name: expires
MediaSignedExpiryQuery.description: Signed Unix expiry. Treat it as opaque client-side.

MediaSignatureQuery.name: signature
MediaSignatureQuery.description: HMAC signature for the local transport request. Treat it as opaque.

PageCursorQuery.name: cursor
PageCursorQuery.description: Opaque cursor returned in the previous page.

InterestQuery.name: interest
InterestQuery.description: Interest themes; existing profile IDs and readable names are accepted and may be repeated. Backend keeps up to 10. Readable names help the generator choose more precise subjects.

FeedbackIdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
FeedbackIdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Stable mutation key; required here unless supplied as idempotencyKey in the JSON body.

V1RecordingRetryOK.description: Current owned recording and retry scheduling result.

V1RecordingDeletedOK.description: Owned recording deleted and its media cleanup scheduled.

V1MediaDownloadOK.description: Short-lived opaque request for owned media content.

V1NoContent.description: Operation completed without a response body.

V1MediaPartStored.description: Local media part stored and verified.

ETag.description: Opaque part entity tag to send to the completion endpoint.

X-Checksum-SHA256.description: Verified lowercase SHA-256 of the uploaded part.

V1MediaContentOK.description: Verified local media content. The content type and length match the stored asset metadata.

V1IdentityCreated.description: Identity and device token grant created.

Set-Cookie.description: Browser grants (`platform: web`) set a scoped HttpOnly rotating refresh cookie. Native grants omit this header.

V1IdentityOK.description: Identity and rotated device token grant.

Set-Cookie.description: Browser grants rotate the scoped HttpOnly refresh cookie. Native grants omit this header.

V1Forbidden.description: The authenticated identity cannot perform this operation; media mutations require a user account.

V1Conflict.description: Identity conflict or guest identity already merged.

V1UnsupportedMediaType.description: The media content type is not allowed for the requested purpose.

V1UnprocessableEntity.description: The declared size or SHA-256 does not match the uploaded bytes.

V1MethodNotAllowed.description: Method not allowed for this resource.

V1CapacityUnavailable.description: Guest preview admission capacity is temporarily exhausted. Retry later without changing the idempotency key.

Retry-After.description: Minimum delay in seconds before retrying.

V1BadGateway.description: The configured upstream service could not complete the request.

V1ArtifactAudioResponseAccepted.description: Durable work queued or still processing.

refreshToken.description: Single-use opaque refresh token returned to native clients by the previous grant. Omit it in browsers; the HttpOnly refresh cookie is used instead.

accessToken.description: Short-lived signed JWT. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

refreshToken.description: Originless native clients only: single-use opaque token. Store it only in OS-protected secure storage. Browser responses omit it and set an HttpOnly cookie instead, regardless of the submitted platform value.

recordingId.description: Stable recording ID, present only when status is promoted.

reason.description: Legacy compatibility field for a previous weekly-quota policy. New valid guest previews are promoted regardless of prior weekly account usage.

duration.description: Client estimate in seconds. The backend replaces it with the measured audio duration before publishing the preview.

timestamp.description: Optional client recording time. The server time is used when omitted.

interviewSessionId.description: Optional adaptive interview session, valid only for topic practice and the same principal. Linked atomically before processing is queued.

id.description: Stable id reused as recordingId after account upgrade.

corrections.description: Zero to two high-confidence corrections. This is never the hidden full analysis result.

processingError.description: Safe generic message returned only when state is failed.

interviewTurns.description: Present only for a saved adaptive topic interview. Each turn keeps the immutable question, learner answer, and optional corrected learner answer separate.

corrections.explanation: Use the past tense for a completed action.

duration.description: Client estimate in seconds. Every authenticated account may save up to 600 seconds per recording; the backend replaces this estimate with the measured audio duration before processing.

photoObject.description: Optional short label for a photo-description prompt.

interviewSessionId.description: Optional adaptive interview session, valid only for topic practice and the same principal. Linked atomically before processing is queued.

contentType.description: Allowed audio types include WebM, MP4/M4A, Ogg, WAV, and MPEG. Allowed photo types are JPEG, PNG, WebP, and GIF.

sizeBytes.description: Exact whole-object size. Recording audio is limited to 80 MiB, interview turn WAV audio to 24 MiB, and photos to 4 MiB; guest final audio remains limited to 10 MiB. All answer WAV uploads for an interview together are limited to 24 MiB for an account or 8 MiB for a guest.

interviewSessionId.description: Required only for interview_turn_audio. Must identify an active interview owned by the same principal; omit for every other media purpose.

url.description: Opaque absolute or relative short-lived URL. Do not persist or modify it.

headers.description: Headers that must be copied exactly to the storage request.

id.description: Stable feedback identity for this anchored result. Optional for older recordings.

excerpt.description: Exact verified excerpt from the learner transcript.

id.description: Stable feedback identity for this anchored result. Optional for older recordings.

downloadPath.description: Stable backend path. Call it with Bearer authentication to receive a short-lived opaque download request.

correctedTranscript.description: Corrected learner transcript used for shadowing. For adaptive interviews this is the chronological question-and-corrected-learner-answer dialogue without role labels. Rewriting uses the current profile level and preserves learner meaning and facts; occasional accessible phrasing from the next CEFR level is allowed.

strengths.description: At most three verified learner examples. Focused feedback mirrors praise here; legacy recordings use the independent strengths job.

media.description: Private owned media references. Exchange each downloadPath for a short-lived opaque download request.

interviewTurns.description: Present only for a saved adaptive topic interview. Each turn keeps the immutable question, learner answer, and optional corrected learner answer separate.

strengthsStatus.description: Independent good-example processing. unknown is used for legacy recordings without coverage information; ready with an empty strengths array means no examples were selected. Failure does not affect corrections, rewriting, or shadowing.

shadowingScript.description: Deprecated experimental fictional-answer payload. No new scripts are generated. Its presence lets clients schedule a one-time replacement with corrected learner audio; the field is cleared when scheduled.

weeklyLimitSeconds.description: Legacy compatibility value: 600 for non-subscribers and null for subscribers. It does not represent or enforce a weekly recording quota.

weeklyUsedSeconds.description: Informational seconds recorded during the current week; this value is not an admission limit.

weeklyRemainingSeconds.description: Legacy compatibility value: fixed at 600 for non-subscribers and null for subscribers. It is never decremented and does not control recording admission.

maxSessionSeconds.description: Per-recording limit for every authenticated account, independent of subscription state.

DailyQuestionsResponse.description: Three opening questions on distinct broad subjects, or one replacement question when count=1.

TopicGuidanceResponse.description: Ten questions after the selected opening question, plus eight topic-specific useful words or phrases.

usefulWords.description: Up to twenty English words or short phrases for answering this candidate question; new generation aims for twenty, empty for legacy candidates.

questionIndex.description: Immutable session artifact index, independent of visible turn sequence. Absent for historical turns until explicit hydration.

usefulWords.description: Up to twenty English words or short phrases for answering this presented question; new generation aims for twenty, empty for legacy turns.

questionIndex.description: Immutable session artifact index, independent of visible turn sequence. Absent for historical turns until explicit hydration.

word.description: English word or short phrase suitable for the learner's profile level.

translation.description: Concise Russian translation shown during interview preparation.

openingUsefulWords.description: Up to twenty English words or short phrases for answering the opening question; new generation aims for twenty. They are shown during the answer, not on the preparation screen.

usefulWords.description: Legacy session-wide English vocabulary. New sessions mirror the opening question's words here for older clients; question-specific words are on turns and candidates.

usefulVocabulary.description: Legacy translated preparation vocabulary. New sessions return an empty array.

candidates.description: The single prepared next question; clients keep it hidden until selected and may fetch its speech audio ahead of time.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Persisted interview limit: 180 seconds for a guest and 600 seconds for an authenticated account.

error.description: Safe preparation failure message when status is failed.

openingQuestion.description: Optional first question. A plain topic label is converted to a broad opening question.

idempotencyKey.description: Alternative to the Idempotency-Key header. Reusing the same key with the same request returns the same session.

skipCurrent.description: True when the learner intentionally leaves the current question unanswered. The skipped turn is excluded from final output.

text.description: Final answer text assembled from Cartesia is_final deltas before flush_done.

FinalizeInterviewRequest.description: Exactly one of recordingId and guestPreviewId identifies the result created with this interviewSessionId.

answerText.description: Speech only, with no synthetic question text.

correctedAnswerText.description: AI-corrected learner answer. Present after an account interview recording completes; it never contains the interviewer question.

answerAlignment.description: Present when full-audio text is assigned to a question using estimated speech timestamps; the canonical transcript remains unchanged.

questionIndex.description: Immutable session artifact index, independent of visible turn sequence. Absent for historical turns until explicit hydration.

FeedbackSpan.description: Half-open UTF-16 offsets into the canonical learner transcript. With turnSequence, offsets are relative to that interview answer. The quoted phrase must equal the referenced slice.

MicroLesson.description: Three curated Russian learning points owned by the server; never model-generated.

originalFragment.description: Verbatim case-sensitive quotation from this learner answer.

occurrence.description: Mandatory 1-based exact whole-word occurrence within the designated answer.

title.description: Contextual Russian heading explaining intended meaning.

explanation.description: One or two Russian sentences explaining the pattern.

practiceText.description: A separate hypothetical English example illustrating this rule, suitable for listening and repetition at the learner level.

audioFeedbackId.description: Opaque feedbackId for the existing feedback audio resource. Use this ID to hear correctedText, rather than the legacy practiceText.

FeedbackPracticeContext.description: Optional sentence or bounded excerpt from the designated learner answer, with only the anchored originalFragment replaced by correctedFragment. Other wording is preserved; clipped excerpts use ellipses. Absent for praise or unverifiable anchors. Computed for saved feedback without reanalysis.

turnSequence.description: Stored interview sequence; absent/zero for free talk or photo description.

FocusedFeedback.description: All confidently identified learner errors, with no numeric limit on errors or total items. Each error has a correction, explanation and rule. Up to one optional praise and one native tip per answer. Questions never receive highlights; all spans are validated and disjoint.

ArtifactAudioResponse.description: GET never starts synthesis. POST starts missing audio or retries failed synthesis, and is a no-op while processing/ready. Ready includes a fresh private signed download request. Signed URL errors must be retried with GET, never regeneration.

AnswerAttempt.description: Separate immutable answer attempt. Original question, subsequent turns and original recording remain unchanged.

CreateAnswerAttemptRequest.description: Supply a stable idempotencyKey here or Idempotency-Key header. Audio must be an owned, ready, unattached interview_attempt_audio asset; duration is verified by the worker.

ReanalyzeFeedbackRequest.description: Explicitly replace original feedback using the focused pipeline. Stable key is required in body or header. Stored attempts are preserved.

englishLevel.description: Profile English level snapshot at generation time.

text.description: Exact audio transcript: immutable question then fictional sample answer, in turn order, joined with spaces.

answerText.description: Fictional speaker answer at the profile CEFR ceiling, independent of learner answers. Maximum 40 words at A1/A2 and 80 words at other levels.
